paper_reference.selection_note: The paper lists 19 explicit MSV accessions despite stating 20 runs; this benchmark uses the explicit 19.
paper_reference.raw_selection_note: Because the paper does not identify the selected RAW within each PXD, one RAW is selected uniformly from sorted .raw candidates per PXD using selection_seed.

selection_policy.candidate_filter: all PRIDE files whose fileName ends with .raw, or .raw.zip only when no direct .raw exists; sorted lexicographically
selection_policy.selection: one candidate per PXD, selected with a seeded uniform random generator
selection_policy.run_count_note: The paper states 20 runs but explicitly lists 19 MSV accessions; no twentieth run is inferred.

conversion.fallback_policy: on converter failure, try remaining candidates sorted by file size then filename

search.checksum_policy: verify PRIDE checksum when it is a recognized MD5, SHA-1, or SHA-256 digest
search.label_rule: positive iff a target Sage PSM has peptide_q < 0.01; all other spectra are negative
